messages:
anya: spun up quokka-v2 (int6 per-channel) on staging for a quick bring-up. ran anchor holdout and a few diagnostics.
sam: sweet. high-level numbers?
anya: eval-bot: baseline opal-v1 (float16): R@1=0.488 R@5=0.719 R@10=0.809
quokka-v2-int6: R@1=0.452 R@5=0.701 R@10=0.769
note: loss concentrated on short queries (<8 tok).
diego: any tokenization/preproc deltas vs opal?
anya: none. identical preproc. quant only: per-channel int6 with small fp16 fallback for >256 tokens.
mira: did you run clustering metrics? silhouette / cluster purity?
anya: yes. ran UMAP -> KMeans(60) -> silhouette_score. baseline 0.221 -> quokka 0.154. UMAP shows some small islands merging for head intents.
sam: how about embedding norms / scale?
anya: median L2 norm dropped ~5.8% on short-query cohort. eval-bot dumps: median cosine drop for 500 failing short queries = 0.014.
diego: sounds like scale bias + projection distortion in early layers. can you dump per-dim std deviation pre/post-quant?
anya: will do. initial quick debug: top-1 flips often move to broader paraphrases instead of exact match. examples: 
 - q: "reset password" 
   baseline top1: "reset password steps"
   quokka top1: "account recovery options"
 - q: "vpn not connecting" 
   baseline top1: "vpn troubleshooting"
   quokka top1: "network issue guide"
mira: those look like specificity loss, not entirely wrong but lower precision. propose three quick experiments:
 1) learn per-dim affine rescale (scale+bias) on a 5k short-query calibration set, apply as post-quant hook.
 2) do a linear least-squares map from quantized embeddings -> float embeddings on calibration set (tiny matrix).
 3) enable fp16 fallback for first projection + re-eval.
sam: agree. prioritize (1) then (3). if (1) fixes norms we can ship as a runtime hook (cheap).
diego: also try per-channel clip calibration (min/max) before quant to reduce tail corruption.
anya: launching runs now: variants A=affine-rescale, B=LSQ-map, C=fp16-fallback-firstproj, D=clip-calib. ops-bot: deployed quokka-v2-int6 to staging pool-bridge-4 (3xA100), tag: quokka-v2-2026-03-23-09:12.
eval-bot: started calibration and recall runs for A/B/C/D on 10k anchor holdout + cohort splits. ETA ~90m.
anya: aside: adding precision@k for cohort (short) and silhouette per-cohort to track.
mira: please also compute label precision@1/5 (where label = exact canonical doc id) for short cohort; that's a clearer signal than overall recall.
sam: if A works, we should test generalization to medium queries too; don't want to overfit short-tail.
diego: once you have per-dim stats, post them here (stddev ratios, mean shifts). could be useful for a small quant-aware retrain too.
anya: will paste stats and a CSV of 50 exemplar failures (baseline vs quokka hits) after runs. pinging when done. :mag_right: :coffee:
